# Mary Joe

## Overview

- **Origin:** the creek  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mary Joe is a buxom [French](../codex/factions.md#french) girl. She is also described as having a broad face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)_

## History

Mary Joe was hired to care for Diana's young sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), while their parents were away at a political rally. When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) became severely ill with croup, Mary Joe grew terrified and panicked, having no knowledge of how to treat the ailment. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) was forced to leave Mary Joe behind with the sick child while she ran to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to seek help.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_
